name: Vaevictis Asmadi
description: Vaevictis Asmadi is a large, aggressive Elder Dragon with a fierce crest, known for terrorizing humans and for his enmity with Nicol Bolas.

description_citations.text: "Vaevictis Asmadi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

summary.text: Vaevictis Asmadi is a large, aggressive Elder Dragon with a fierce crest, known for terrorizing humans and for his enmity with Nicol Bolas.

citations.text: "Vaevictis Asmadi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

bio.text: Vaevictis was spawned in the second egg-fall by the Ur-Dragon and guarded a hunting territory with his siblings, until humans became dragon hunters and only three siblings survived.

citations.text: "Vaevictis Asmadi", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Vaevictis Asmadi", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Vaevictis and his siblings chased the young Nicol while burning human settlements, and Ugin frightened them off so Nicol could escape.

citations.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.
"Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.
"Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

bio.text: Seven of Vaevictis' descendants raided Bolas's lands, starting the Elder Dragon War, and Vaevictis and his siblings defeated Bolas's army.

citations.text: "Vaevictis Asmadi", section "Elder Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Vaevictis Asmadi", section "Elder Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Elder Dragon War", section "Start of the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Bolas's sorcerers killed Ravus and Bolas turned Lividus against Vaevictis, enabling Bolas to escape, and Lividus died, leaving Vaevictis the only survivor of his brood.

citations.text: "Vaevictis Asmadi", section "Elder Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Lividus", section "Elder Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Lividus", section "Elder Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Faralyn later transformed him into a dragon whelp, and he pretended to be controlled by Red Donald to reach Mors Ridge and free Palladia-Mors, who restored his form.

citations.text: "Vaevictis Asmadi", section "Faralyn's  spell". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Vaevictis Asmadi", section "Faralyn's  spell". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Chromium convinced him that Palladia-Mors meant to use him, and he attacked her and she banished him with his own reversed spell.

citations.text: "Vaevictis Asmadi", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

status.text: As of the latest story, Vaevictis was banished by Palladia-Mors with his own reversed spell, and the material does not say what became of him afterward.

citations.text: "Vaevictis Asmadi", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Palladia-Mors", section "Battle at Mors Ridge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vaevictis wakes Palladia, who rampages at Mors Ridge; Chromium and Ad'Amra put her back to sleep.
timeline.quote: managed to put the sleep-spell back on Palladia

citation.text: "Chromium Rhuell", section "Ham, the Tickery Man". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Descendants of Vaevictis raid Bolas's lands, are defeated, then Vaevictis and his siblings defeat Bolas's army, which retreats.
timeline.quote: Bolas' army suffered a shattering defeat and had to retreat into the mountains

citation.text: "Elder Dragon War", section "Start of the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas's sorcerers kill Ravus and Bolas overpowers Lividus's mind and turns him against Vaevictis, allowing escape.
timeline.quote: the sorcerers of Bolas' army managed to kill Ravus

citation.text: "Elder Dragon War", section "Start of the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the twins spend years perfecting tandem hunting, and meet Vaevictis Asmadi's territory.
timeline.quote: We spent years, as you Jeskai would measure the span of days, perfecting various techniques for hunting in tandem.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ugin finds Vaevictis Asmadi and his siblings chasing Nicol while burning human settlements.
timeline.quote: They were chasing a dragon.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ugin frightens Vaevictis off with spun globes of light so Nicol can escape.
timeline.quote: So, I reached into my tiny arsenal of magical tricks and spun a pair of transparent, feather-light globes out of the nexus of colors and into the air.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Dragons descended from Vaevictis raid the kingdom's settlements, and the king resolves to fight them with his army and venom-laced weapons.
timeline.quote: We are the descendants of Vaevictis Asmadi and may raid where we wish!

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The king's army slaughters seven of Vaevictis's descendants with ballistae and sorcery but one escapes.
timeline.quote: It was a rout. A slaughter.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The king pursues the survivor across the plains and meets Vaevictis, Lividus, Ravus and Rubra, who drop the dead dragon onto the army.
timeline.quote: The corpse hit hard, instantly crushing an entire company of slingers.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The king's ballistae wound Rubra with a venom bolt, but the army is routed by Vaevictis's fire.
timeline.quote: Rubra took a bolt to the eye.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol uses mind touch on Lividus to turn him against Vaevictis and sets the two brothers against each other.
timeline.quote: He pressed the venom-tipped spear of his sharp mind deep into Lividus's simmering rancor.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Vaevictis and Lividus fight each other as Nicol retreats and kills his own witnesses.
timeline.quote: Traitor! Backstabber!

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas ignites Lividus's resentment, and Lividus turns on Vaevictis while Bolas escapes.
timeline.quote: Lividus rose to meet him with a roar

citation.text: "Lividus", section "Elder Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lividus dies at an unknown time; Vaevictis is the only one of his brood to survive.
timeline.quote: Vaevictis would be the only one of his brood to survive the Elder Dragon war

citation.text: "Lividus", section "Elder Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Red Donald digs canals at the urging of his whelp familiar, awakening Palladia-Mors.
timeline.quote: This awoke Palladia-Mors.

citation.text: "Palladia-Mors", section "Battle at Mors Ridge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Palladia and Vaevictis wreak havoc with an army of zombies and orcs and kill Red Donald; Ad'Amra takes the lead of the Army of the Valley.
timeline.quote: killing Red Donald

citation.text: "Palladia-Mors", section "Battle at Mors Ridge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ham is revealed to be Chromium Rhuell; Vaevictis disappears from the battle and Ad'Amra and Chromium put the sleep spell back on Palladia.
timeline.quote: Ham was the benevolent Elder Dragon Chromium Rhuell

citation.text: "Palladia-Mors", section "Battle at Mors Ridge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Battle at Mors Ridge sees the first downfalls of Vaevictis Asmadi and Palladia-Mors.
timeline.quote: the Battle at Mors Ridge on Aerona witnessed the first downfalls of two of the surviving Elder Dragons

citation.text: "Time of Legends", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vaevictis is spawned in the second egg-fall by the Ur-Dragon and guards a hunting territory with his siblings.
timeline.quote: Vaevictis was spawned during the Birth of the Elder Dragons

citation.text: "Vaevictis Asmadi", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Humans in the territory become dragon hunters; only three siblings survive.
timeline.quote: only three of Vaevictis' siblings were still alive

citation.text: "Vaevictis Asmadi", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Seven of Vaevictis' descendants raid Bolas' lands, starting the Elder Dragon War.
timeline.quote: The Elder Dragon War started when seven descendants of Vaevictis raided the lands of Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Vaevictis Asmadi", section "Elder Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vaevictis and his siblings defeat Bolas' army; Rubra is killed by a poisoned arrow.
timeline.quote: Although Rubra was killed by a poisoned arrow, Bolas' army suffered a shattering defeat

citation.text: "Vaevictis Asmadi", section "Elder Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas' sorcerers kill Ravus and Bolas turns Lividus against Vaevictis, enabling escape.
timeline.quote: the sorcerers of Bolas' army managed to kill Ravus

citation.text: "Vaevictis Asmadi", section "Elder Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Faralyn transforms Vaevictis into a dragon whelp.
timeline.quote: Vaevictis Asmadi was transformed into a dragon whelp by the planeswalker

citation.text: "Vaevictis Asmadi", section "Faralyn's  spell". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vaevictis pretends to be controlled by Red Donald to reach Mors Ridge and free Palladia-Mors, who restores his form, beginning the Battle at Mors Ridge.
timeline.quote: thus the Battle at Mors Ridge had begun

citation.text: "Vaevictis Asmadi", section "Faralyn's  spell". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chromium convinces Vaevictis that Palladia-Mors meant to use him; Vaevictis attacks her and she banishes him with his own reversed spell.
timeline.quote: Palladia-Mors reversed one of his spells, and he disappeared into nowhere.

citation.text: "Vaevictis Asmadi", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Vaevictis and siblings chase Nicol; Nicol calls them hateful creatures

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Things Unseen" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2018.
